title: Common RL abstractions: AlgorithmConfig, BaseAgentAlgorithm, ReplayBuffer, RolloutBuffer, networks, registry
plan_items: 1.4 (common interface, common ReplayBuffer, noise outside forward)
purpose: Define the contract every policy implements and the shared components, so that the five DRL algorithms and three baselines can be ported in parallel (rl_algorithms) and the runtime (runtime_core) can be written against one interface.

modify: abmem/services/algorithms/__init__.py (no eager imports of algorithm modules)

abmem/services/algorithms/agent_algorithm.py (transitional only: move the five 'from .X import ...' lines and the algorithm_utils import from module level into the branches of AgentAlgorithm.__init__/methods, so that importing agent_service, market_service, simulation_service, starter_service and views keeps working while wave 2 rewrites DDPG.py, TD3.py, SAC.py, ppo.py and RDPG.py. public_interfaces.signature:
class AlgorithmType(enum.Enum):
    DDPG = 0
    RDPG = 1
    TD3 = 2
    SAC = 3
    PPO = 4
    RANDOM = 5
    MARGINAL_COST = 6
    FIXED_MARKUP = 7
public_interfaces.description: django_enumfield Enum, consistent with existing enums. Used by Agent.algorithm_type (data_model) and HPOStudy.algorithm_type. The algorithm layer may import abmem.models.enums (enum definitions) but never model classes.

public_interfaces.signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AlgorithmConfig:
    gamma: float = 0.99
    tau: float = 0.005
    lr_actor: float = 3e-4
    lr_critic: float = 3e-4
    batch_size: int = 64
    buffer_size: int = 100_000
    learning_starts: int = 64
    gradient_steps: int = 1
    hidden_sizes: tuple[int, ...] = (256, 256)
    exploration_sigma: float = 0.1
    exploration_sigma_decay: float = 1.0
    exploration_sigma_min: float = 0.0
    max_grad_norm: float | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> Self
    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]
    def replace(self, **changes: Any) -> Self
    @classmethod
    def default_search_bounds(cls) -> dict[str, tuple[float, float, Literal['linear', 'log', 'int']]]
public_interfaces.description: Frozen. __post_init__ validates ranges (0 < gamma < 1, 0 < tau <= 1, lr > 0, batch_size >= 1, buffer_size >= batch_size, learning_starts >= batch_size, gradient_steps >= 1, sigma >= 0, 0 < decay <= 1, all floats finite). from_dict(None) returns defaults (A2). Unknown keys raise ValueError naming the key. Integer fields accept floats with integral value from the optimizer, other floats raise. Defaults are the published defaults (Lillicrap 2016, Fujimoto 2018, Haarnoja 2018, Schulman 2017) pending OQ-3.

All frozen dataclasses. PPO validation: rollout_length >= minibatch_size, 0 <= gae_lambda <= 1, clip_eps > 0. RDPG: seq_len >= 2. FixedMarkup: markup > -1. Defaults: PPO rollout_length = 64 (OQ-4), FixedMarkup markup = 0.10 on (fuelCost + staticCost) (OQ-6), gradient_steps_per_period = 1 and learning_starts = 64 (OQ-3).

public_interfaces.signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Transition:
    obs: np.ndarray
    action: np.ndarray
    reward: float
    next_obs: np.ndarray
    terminated: bool = False

public_interfaces.description: obs and next_obs are normalised float32 (obs_dim,). action is the applied normalised action. reward is a float (never int, C1). __post_init__ rejects non-finite values.
Returned by update() when at least one gradient step was taken.

public_interfaces.signature:
class BaseAgentAlgorithm(abc.ABC):
    algorithm_type: ClassVar[AlgorithmType]
    is_learning: ClassVar[bool]
    is_on_policy: ClassVar[bool]
    config_class: ClassVar[type[AlgorithmConfig]]

    def __init__(self, spec: PolicySpec, config: AlgorithmConfig, rng: np.random.Generator) -> None
    @abc.abstractmethod
    def select_action(self, obs: np.ndarray, explore: bool) -> ActionResult
    def observe(self, transition: Transition) -> None
    def update(self) -> UpdateStats | None
    def end_period(self) -> None
    def set_frozen(self, frozen: bool) -> None
    def exploration_scale(self) -> float | None
    @property
    def ready_to_learn(self) -> bool
    @property
    def frozen(self) -> bool
public_interfaces.description: Template base class. __init__ checks isinstance(config, self.config_class). observe/update are no-ops when frozen. update returns None unless ready_to_learn (len(buffer) >= config.learning_starts) (B7). end_period applies exploration decay once per period (sigma = max(sigma_min, sigma * decay)). select_action is called under torch.no_grad() and adds exploration noise only when explore is True (C3). Networks are moved to device.get_device().

public_interfaces.signature:
class ReplayBuffer:
    def __init__(self, obs_dim: int, action_dim: int, capacity: int, rng: np.random.Generator) -> None
    def add(self, t: Transition) -> None
    def __len__(self) -> int
    def sample(self, batch_size: int, device: torch.device) -> 'Batch'
    def sample_sequences(self, batch_size: int, seq_len: int, device: torch.device) -> 'SequenceBatch'
public_interfaces.description: Numpy ring buffer (float32 obs, actions, rewards, next_obs, terminated, intervened). sample draws indices without replacement when len >= batch_size, else raises ValueError (callers check ready_to_learn). sample_sequences returns windows of seq_len consecutive stored transitions that do not cross the ring-buffer write position, shape (B, L, dim). Single shared implementation (A10).

public_interfaces.signature:
class RolloutBuffer:
    def __init__(self, obs_dim: int, action_dim: int, length: int) -> None
    def add(self, t: Transition) -> None
    def full(self) -> bool
    def clear(self) -> None
    def compute_gae(self, last_value: float, gamma: float, gae_lambda: float) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]
public_interfaces.description: Fixed-length on-policy storage. add requires behaviour_log_prob, behaviour_value and pre_squash (ValueError otherwise). compute_gae implements Schulman et al. 2016 eq. 16: A_t = sum_l (gamma * lambda)^l delta_{t+l}, delta_t = r_t + gamma * (1 - terminated_t) * V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t), returns (advantages, returns = advantages + values). Masks for intervened steps are exposed for PPO.

public_interfaces.signature:
def mlp(in_dim: int, out_dim: int, hidden: Sequence[int], activation: type[nn.Module] = nn.ReLU) -> nn.Sequential
class DeterministicActor(nn.Module): forward(obs: Tensor) -> Tensor  # tanh output in [-1, 1]
class QCritic(nn.Module): forward(obs: Tensor, action: Tensor) -> Tensor  # shape (B, 1)
class RecurrentDeterministicActor(nn.Module): forward(obs_seq: Tensor, hidden: tuple[Tensor, Tensor] | None = None) -> tuple[Tensor, tuple[Tensor, Tensor]]
class RecurrentQCritic(nn.Module): forward(obs_seq: Tensor, action_seq: Tensor, hidden: tuple[Tensor, Tensor] | None = None) -> Tensor  # (B, L, 1)
def soft_update(target: nn.Module, source: nn.Module, tau: float) -> None
def hard_update(target: nn.Module, source: nn.Module) -> None
public_interfaces.description: No noise, no clamp, no per-sample normalisation inside forward (C3, C4). Final actor layer initialised U(-3e-3, 3e-3) (Lillicrap 2016, sec. 7). RecurrentQCritic consumes the per-step action sequence (B3). hidden None means zero initial state.
cuda if torch.cuda.is_available() else cpu. Single place for device selection.

test_contract_helper.signature: def assert_policy_contract(policy: BaseAgentAlgorithm, spec: PolicySpec, n_steps: int = 300) -> None
test_contract_helper.description: Reusable contract test used by every rl_algorithms package: output shape == action_dim, values in [-1, 1], finite, explore=False deterministic, no update before learning_starts, update returns UpdateStats after learning_starts for learning policies, frozen policy does not change parameters, observe accepts float rewards and stores them unchanged as float32.

data_model_changes: AlgorithmType enum only (no field, no migration)
invariants: No module-level mutable state in the new modules of services/algorithms (hyperparameters exist only in config instances).
Every buffer stores normalised observations and normalised actions in float32.
Rewards are stored as float32 without rounding (C1).
Network forward passes are deterministic functions of inputs and parameters.
After this spec, 'import abmem.services.agent.agent_service' succeeds regardless of the state of DDPG.py, TD3.py, SAC.py, ppo.py, RDPG.py.
edge_cases: from_dict with legacy uppercase keys (e.g. 'NOISE_STD'): ValueError listing accepted keys (legacy ABC logs are not imported).
from_dict with NaN or Inf values: ValueError.
ReplayBuffer.sample with fewer stored transitions than batch_size: ValueError.
ReplayBuffer wrap-around: oldest entries overwritten, sample_sequences never returns a window spanning the overwrite boundary.
RolloutBuffer.add beyond length: ValueError (caller must update and clear).
compute_gae with length 1 and with terminated flags all False.
Unknown AlgorithmType value: KeyError with message.
